executiveSummary: Dub Dub POS transfers show $33,980.00 sent into Operations: $17,420.00 Savings and $16,560.00 Black Box.

Operations paid out $60,774.01 during the same period, so the Operations ledger has enough outgoing activity to absorb the Dub Dub money, but the cash is pooled and not directly tagged back to Dub Dub transfer IDs.
Confirmed labelled uses total $33,879.01. The largest labelled buckets are Other labelled payout $7,638.00, Rent / overhead $5,015.00, Stock orders $17,737.00.
Unclear or adjustment-looking Operations outflows total $26,895.00. These should not be treated as explained physical cash use until receipts or notes are added.
